messages:
incident-bot: [ALERT] Elevated 5xx rate on Dedicated cluster polarisx-prod (customer: PolarisX) — spike detected across gateway + serving tier, paging oncall. https://infra.redwood/alerts/2955012345 :rotating_light:

mike-oncall: got the page, joining. can someone grab current customer impact?

ashley-sre: seeing gateway 502/504s from frontend -> router for tenant polarisx. 5xx rate ~1500/min over baseline, error budget approaching. latency tail increasing  p95->p99.

jamal-runtime: backend says GPU queue depth hit 98% on pool polarisx-gpu-1, lots of kv eviction events on redis-kv-2. suspect noisy tenant or spike in seq len.

mike-oncall: ok. @jamal-runtime can you confirm if it's noisy neighbor or genuine traffic surge from customer? any sudden model size/seq changes?

jamal-runtime: checking request histograms. customer request rate up ~2.8x last 12m, median seq length up from 256->1800 for many traces. plenty of long-running streams.

ashley-sre: also seeing increased prefix cache miss rate for polarisx keyed requests. KV evictions spiking: 53k evictions in last 10m.

nora-eng: pinging infra metrics: GPU utilization per instance at 97-100% with OOM throttles on a couple hosts.

mike-oncall: immediate mitigations: 1) throttle heavy seq-length requests via gateway rule 2) temporarily increase dedicated pool by +2 nodes 3) notify CS. I'll start 2 and 1 in parallel.

jamal-runtime: command to scale pool: 
```
./infractl scale-pool --cluster polarisx-prod --pool polarisx-gpu-1 --delta 2
```
kicking now. ETA ~2m for nodes to join.

ashley-sre: adding gateway rule now to cap per-connection token length to 1200 with soft-429. will apply to tenant polarisx only: 
```
apply config gateway.rules {
  match tenant == "polarisx"
  action throttle {
    max_tokens_per_request: 1200
    response_code: 429
  }
}
```
rolling.

deploy-bot: deployment started by ashley-sre: gateway-rule-pol-2955012345 v1 -> canary 10% (sha: a1b2c3).

mike-oncall: @eva-cs can you prepare a short customer message noting degraded inference throughput and that we are applying throttles and adding capacity? keep it neutral, ETA ~10-15m for relief.

eva-cs: drafting: "Hi PolarisX team — we’re seeing elevated errors and timeouts on your dedicated cluster due to a sudden increase in long requests. We are applying temporary throttles and adding capacity; you may see short-lived 429s for very long requests. We expect improved stability within ~15 minutes. Apologies for the disruption; we’ll follow up with root cause and next steps." send?

mike-oncall: send now.

eva-cs: sent to PolarisX primary contact + account slack.

jamal-runtime: new nodes are joining; instance health ok, but KV eviction backlog still climbing. suspect redis KVS size configured close to memory limit for tenant namespace.

ashley-sre: quick mitigation: enable tenant-specific KV eviction grace window to prioritize polarisx prefixes. command: 
```
kvctl set-policy --namespace polarisx --eviction-priority:high
```
applied.

nora-eng: metrics update: 5xx rate down ~40% after gateway throttle + scale; GPU utilization down to ~78% on average. p99 latency still elevated but trending down.

mike-oncall: good. keep monitoring. can we identify which request pattern is most costly? any spike in stream + function calling?

jamal-runtime: yes - long chat streams with repeated tool calls and long contexts. root cause seems customer is sending multi-file transcripts as a single prompt. we need a durable long-term fix (quota guidance + chunked ingestion recommendation).

ashley-sre: open a follow-up with product docs + CS to add guidance and default token caps for Dedicated customers.

mike-oncall: transitioning to incident handoff mode. on-call for next shift @ashley-sre. I’ll put a summary.

ashley-sre: taking over. thanks @mike-oncall. leaving the mitigation steps and follow-ups: 
- short-term: gateway throttle (1200 tokens), +2 GPUs, KV policy tweak.
- medium-term: recommend per-tenant request size limits + quota enforcement and customer guidance.
- postmortem owner: jamal-runtime (root cause analysis + action items).

mike-oncall: notes: customer impact was ~10% of requests getting 5xx/timeout in spike window; no data exposure, no fail-open on private data. total outage window ~18m until stable.

eva-cs: PolarisX replied: "Thanks, we see improvement. We'll throttle on our side and break up requests. Please loop us on RCA."

jamal-runtime: capturing logs for RCA: 
```
grep "tenant=polarisx" /var/log/runtime/requests.log | grep "seq_len"
# sample: req_id=abc123 seq_len=18400 tokens=16200 time=12.3s
```
saving to /tmp/polarisx-long-requests-2955012345.log

nora-eng: adding follow-ups: autoscale policy tweak for Dedicated pools to allow faster burst nodes for tenant-specific spikes, and KV memory margin increase flag.

ashley-sre: marking this thread resolved for paging. moving to follow-up in #postmortems and assigning ticket INF-4721 to jamal-runtime.

mike-oncall: thanks team. closing page. :white_check_mark:
